name: Can noisy pipes be a sign of high water pressure?

mainEntity.name: Can noisy pipes be a sign of high water pressure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, noisy pipes can definitely be a sign of high water pressure. Excessively high water pressure can cause water to flow too quickly and forcefully through your pipes, leading to banging, vibrating, or even whistling sounds. Over time, high water pressure can also put undue stress on your plumbing fixtures, appliances, and pipe joints, potentially shortening their lifespan and causing leaks. Installing a pressure reducing valve (PRV) is a common solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, noisy pipes can indicate high water pressure, which can cause banging, vibrating, or whistling and damage plumbing components over time.
